gripOrHq.title: Edited Shipping Manifests
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, and the Corp has any credits when you would access HQ, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [1] and gives you a tag, and you gain [10].

gripOrHq.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

heapOrArchives.title: Forged Activation Orders
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

heapOrArchives.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

heapOrArchives.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

heapOrArchives.title: Junkyard BBS
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Junkyard BBS
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Priority Wreck
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

ice.title: Nerve Labyrinth
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Hunting Pack
ice.rulesText: For each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Hunting Pack, Hunting Pack has one subroutine as follows: "*Trace 5-If trace is successful, give Runner a tag."

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.

root.title: Manhunt
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during his or her last turn. Trace 6-If trace is successful, give Runner one tag for each point by which your trace exceeded his or her link.

root.title: Scorched Earth
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 4 meat damage.

root.title: TRAP!
root.rulesText: If you pay [4] when Runner accesses TRAP!, it does 3 Net damage and gives Runner a tag, even if TRAP! is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If TRAP! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.
